text:
The two forced blocks are Ben–Cara–Dev in three consecutive slots and Hana–Ivo in two consecutive slots. Ivo is before Cara, and Finn is at least three slots before Hana, so Finn, Hana, and Ivo all sit before Cara, with Ben in the slot immediately before her. That pushes Ben–Cara–Dev to slots 7–8–9 and Hana–Ivo to 5–6, with Finn in 1.

Slots 2, 3, and 4 are left for Ann, Elif, and Gus. Elif before Ivo, Ann before Gus, exactly one slot between Elif and Gus, and Ann at least three slots from Ivo place them as Elif, Ann, Gus.

Every other block placement leaves a slot that nobody can take or breaks the separation or order rules. This assignment meets all fifteen constraints.
